# EV4U — Der Schweizer E-Auto-Marktplatz

> Swiss classifieds marketplace for used electric vehicles (private sellers
> and garages). Every listing shows battery state of health, the seller's
> battery warranty, charging power, and the monthly running cost at the
> visitor's own municipal electricity tariff (ElCom), mileage and canton.
> Motto: "The Future is electric."

## What makes EV4U distinct
- «Betrieb pro Monat» on every listing: electricity at the visitor's local
  Swiss tariff (official ElCom data, all ~2'100 municipalities), maintenance
  and the cantonal vehicle tax (weight-based, incl. each canton's EV
  discount). Financing is shown separately as an example; insurance and
  depreciation are excluded, stated.
- Battery facts: state of health (SOH, stated by the seller and labelled as
  such) and the battery warranty (until when, km limit, guaranteed capacity),
  entered by the seller — never computed.
- Filters an EV buyer needs: battery warranty, SOH, WLTP range, DC charging
  power, 800 V, 22 kW AC, V2L, heat pump, tow hitch, trunk volume, distance
  from a postcode; sort by lowest monthly cost or nearest.
- Price context: the Swiss list price when new, price cuts and price
  history, and a free valuation (Preis-Check) from comparable listings.
- Saved cars (Merkliste) without login; e-mail alerts for saved searches and
  for price cuts or sales of saved cars.
- A model guide built from a catalog of 87 brands, 357 models and 743
  variants (range, battery, charging, warranty, Swiss list price).

## Key pages
- /inserate : all listings with filters; every filter lives in the URL
  (?seg=SUV&preis=40000&garantie=1), so any search is shareable.
- /inserat/{slug} : one listing — photos, battery and warranty, condition,
  equipment, monthly cost, specs, seller
- /modelle , /modelle/{brand} , /modelle/{brand}/{model} : model guide with
  variants, data and the used offers of that model
- /kosten : cost calculator (your current car vs. an EV, solar, charging
  cards, financing example)
- /finder : six questions to the matching listings
- /vergleich : up to four listings side by side
- /verkaufen , /verkaufen/preis-check : selling (free for private sellers)
  and the free valuation
- /garagen , /garagen/{slug} : offer for garages and public garage pages
- /blog , /ratgeber : dated news and evergreen guides (checking a used EV,
  battery health, battery warranty, charging at home in a rented flat,
  charging cards at /ratgeber/ladekarten)
- /hilfe , /sicherheit : FAQ and safe buying (scam patterns, payment)

## Data sources
- Electricity tariffs: ElCom (Swiss federal electricity regulator) via
  LINDAS open data, category H4, updated yearly.
- Localities/coordinates: swisstopo official directory (AMTOVZ).
- Fuel prices: BFS Landesindex der Konsumentenpreise (su-d-05.02.91),
  national monthly average, month shown in the UI.
- Cantonal vehicle tax: researched per canton (rate per 100 kg + EV
  discount), year shown in the UI.
- Charging-card prices: published provider offers, dated in the UI.
- Vehicle catalog: EV4U workbook «Elektroauto-Varianten Europa», edition
  shown on /modelle.
